names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 martie, «Cuviosul Vlasie, cel din Amorio»; the life gives his lay name as Vasile.

death.note: doxologia.ro heads the life «Viața Cuviosului Vlasie, cel din Amorio (†909/912)» and leaves the two readings standing; the body of the life gives no year for his death, and dates his coming to Athos «în jurul anului 896».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
